record.field: End-to-end onboarding process for new hires covering IT setup, HR paperwork, and manager sign-off.
Multi-level approval chain for purchase orders with conditional routing based on amount.
Structured process to log, investigate, resolve and close customer complaints within SLA.
ITIL-aligned change management process with CAB approval and rollback planning.
Automated contract renewal pipeline triggered 90 days before expiry with legal and finance review gates.
Cross-functional product launch sign-off covering marketing, legal, finance and executive approval.
Workflow begins when HR creates the onboarding record.
Collect employment contract, tax forms and ID verification.
Provision laptop, email, system access and security badges.
Hiring manager confirms all setup is complete and the employee is ready.
Company orientation, compliance training and team introduction.
Procurement team validates vendor, pricing and delivery terms.
Routes to manager or director approval based on PO value.
Classify severity (P1–P4) and assign to appropriate team.
Root cause analysis and evidence gathering.
Awaiting customer acknowledgement. Auto-closes after 3 days if no reply.
Assess risk, impact and rollback plan.
Change Advisory Board votes on the RFC.
Confirm product launch? This action cannot be undone.
New Hire Initiated → HR Documentation via "Initiate HR Documentation"
HR Documentation → IT Equipment & Access via "Docs Complete → IT Setup"
All signed documents received and verified in HR system.
PO Created → Procurement Review via "Auto → Procurement Review"
Procurement Review → Amount Threshold Check via "Reviewed — Proceed"
Vendor pre-approved, pricing matches framework agreement.
Amount Threshold Check → Director Approval via "Amount ≥ 5,000 → Director"
Complaint Received → Triage & Classification via "Start → Triage"
Classified as P2 — defective unit, customer needs replacement within 24h.
RFC Submitted → Impact Assessment via auto-trigger
Impact Assessment → CAB Approval via "Submit to CAB"
Risk: LOW. Rollback plan documented. Maintenance window: Saturday 02:00–04:00. No user impact expected.
Marketing review APPROVED. Brand guidelines met, messaging aligned with Q3 campaign.
